narrative.overview: A landscape-led portfolio where deep alpine color, slow atmospheric movement, and concrete technical evidence make systems work feel expansive and grounded.
keyCharacteristics: Landscape-led atmosphere with moving light and precise linework.
Strong sans-serif display paired with an italic serif for moments of lift.
Flat information bands, trail-like experience entries, and oversized project panels.

rules.name: The Altitude Rule
rules.body: Dark surfaces carry the high-contrast content; light surfaces are used as spacious rests, never as generic card backgrounds.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Use serif only as a deliberate counterpart within a display phrase or a project title line; body content remains sans-serif.

rules.name: The Terrain Rule
rules.body: Shadows must feel like distance in the landscape, not like floating dashboard cards.

dos: Do let the Himalayan image remain visible and legible as an environment, not a texture.
Do use the alpenglow accent selectively for action and directional detail.
Do preserve motion as slow, whole-surface atmosphere with a reduced-motion fallback.
Do keep project and experience copy concrete, measured, and easy to scan.
donts: Don't add generic icon grids, glass panels, or pill-shaped interface chrome.
Don't put serif typography into dense technical copy.
Don't use multiple card systems to replace the experience trail or project rail.
Don't let hero typography clip at mobile widths.
